how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-arathi-highlands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:665:obj:0: Escort Professor Phizzlethorpe to the cave and back.
rows.quest:665:details:0: Now that we are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders it is our job to help Mr. O'Breen locate the lost elven treasure.
rows.quest:665:details:1: It is next to impossible to find the gems in the dark sea without aid. The doctor has constructed some goggles that will help. He needs the goggles charged with the energy derived from the enchanted stone in the cave just up the hill.
rows.quest:665:details:2: But the cave is cursed! When we get close, we get ambushed. Defend me and I can harness the energy from the stone into the goggles.
rows.quest:665:progress:0: This is no time to talk! The goggles need to be charged with the power of the stone!
rows.quest:665:completion:0: The goggles work perfectly now! Well done, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:666:obj:0: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 ⟦E1⟧ and return the ⟦E2⟧ once you are done.
rows.quest:666:details:0: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.
rows.quest:666:details:1: BA little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!
rows.quest:666:details:2: So borrow the ⟦E2⟧, ⟦2⟧, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.
rows.quest:666:details:3: I'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
rows.quest:666:progress:0: How did the goggles work? Did everything function properly? Adjustments can be made if necessary.⟦3⟧⟦4⟧Oh, and I'll need those goggles back when you're done. I am sure Captain O'Breen will have many uses for them later on.
rows.quest:666:completion:0: Most superb, ⟦5⟧! The Captain will be very pleased! And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!
rows.quest:668:details:0: Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. He'll want to see these gems first hand. After all, that's why we're here!
rows.quest:668:details:1: And after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.
rows.quest:668:progress:0: Ahoy, ⟦7⟧. What brings you to the bridge?
rows.quest:668:completion:0: So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!
rows.quest:669:obj:0: Take the ⟦E3⟧ to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:669:details:0: Fleet Master Seahorn will want to hear about our find at once.
rows.quest:669:details:1: But as you can see, we're not in much of a position to get out of here. Not only is the tide too low, but those damned creatures we disrupted are keeping a close eye on our movements.
rows.quest:669:details:2: You can be of great service to the Blackwater Raiders if you can get word to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay that we discovered the treasure and are working on extracting more. Take him this sample as proof.
rows.quest:669:progress:0: What brings you to Booty Bay, ⟦8⟧?
rows.quest:669:completion:0: Ah, leave it to good old Shakes O'Breen! I knew that he was the right Captain for the mission!
rows.quest:670:obj:0: Deliver Seahorn's Letter to Shakes O'Breen in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:670:details:0: Say, ⟦9⟧, you seem to be an adventurous type. My fleet is stuck in Booty Bay until we can restock.
rows.quest:670:details:1: There are some heavy things brewing here and abroad and I need to get some top secret correspondence to Shakes O'Breen who is tied up off the Arathi coast.
rows.quest:670:details:2: Can I trust you to deliver this message safely and in confidence?
rows.quest:670:progress:0: So was Seahorn impressed? I bet you his smile reached from Booty Bay to Ratchet.
rows.quest:670:completion:0: Thank you for making such a long and perilous journey. You have the gratitude of the Blackwater Raiders.
rows.quest:673:obj:0: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to ⟦E5⟧'gan in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:673:details:0: There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. We must remove the source of his energy.
rows.quest:673:details:1: Find the warlock and kill him. Bring me whatever magical object you find on his person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.
rows.quest:673:progress:0: The burning in my blood... it grows by the day. The warlock must be stopped.
rows.quest:673:completion:0: My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. Thank you, ⟦10⟧. It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:679:obj:0: Kill 7 Boulderfist ⟦E8⟧ and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the ⟦E6⟧ outpost.
rows.quest:679:details:0: The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, ⟦11⟧. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.
rows.quest:679:details:1: Find and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.
rows.quest:679:progress:0: I see your courage finally wanes. It seems my instincts were correct about you: your strength is nothing compared to your bravado.⟦12⟧⟦13⟧Return to me when the beast's head has been severed, or return never again.
rows.quest:679:completion:0: You do your people proud, ⟦14⟧. The ⟦E9⟧ has been greatly lessened, and I am sure we will begin to thrive here in the Highlands.
rows.quest:680:obj:0: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his ⟦E10⟧ to Korin Fel in the ⟦E6⟧ outpost.
rows.quest:680:details:0: You serve my husband well, ⟦15⟧, but he does not know why ⟦E6⟧ is under attack.
rows.quest:680:details:1: Or'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, has an intense hatred for my husband, and wishes nothing more than my husband's death for defeating him years ago.
rows.quest:680:details:2: My auguries tell me that Or'Kalar has laid a trap for my husband, so I have hidden signs of the ogre's presence from him.
rows.quest:680:details:3: My husband will rush off foolishly if he learns of the ogre's whereabouts and I would ask for your help in slaying the creature.
rows.quest:680:progress:0: Near the Tower of Arathor--that is where you will find Or'Kalar. His death will stop the attacks on ⟦E6⟧ and protect my husband's life.⟦16⟧⟦17⟧I see in your eyes that you think me weak--even dishonorable--for my ⟦E11⟧. Some day you will learn what it is to love as I do. Perhaps then you will understand a different kind of strength and honor.⟦18⟧⟦19⟧In the meantime, do as I ask, and slay Or'Kalar.
rows.quest:680:completion:0: You have done me a great service, ⟦20⟧. Know that my husband's life and the safety of ⟦E6⟧ has been protected for another day because of your deeds. Please take this as a reward for your courage.
rows.quest:685:obj:0: Bring ⟦E12⟧ and ⟦E13⟧ to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:685:details:0: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto. Falconcrest heads the ⟦E14⟧'s efforts in the ⟦E4⟧, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.
rows.quest:685:details:1: His bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic ⟦E15⟧, is a fierce ⟦E16⟧ and has killed dozens of our defenders.
rows.quest:685:details:2: Their bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
rows.quest:685:progress:0: Hello. Do you have a report to submit?
rows.quest:685:completion:1: Here is your reward, ⟦21⟧. I am happy to pay it.
rows.quest:687:details:0: ⟦E17⟧ was once a member of our order, the Twilight's ⟦E18⟧. But he lost his mind and scorned our teachings. And before he fled from us, he stole the scroll of ⟦E19⟧! We could not catch him, but rumors say he hides in the ⟦E20⟧, gibbering and mad.
rows.quest:687:details:1: To bring the Lady back to us, you must find the scroll. And to do that, you must find Theldurin.
rows.quest:687:completion:0: Hello. Hello, hello hello hello hello HELLO!
rows.quest:687:completion:1: I'm sorry - wait, no I'm not! Don't be rude!
rows.quest:687:completion:3: But...sometimes being crazy is my only solace.
rows.quest:688:details:1: Free! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
rows.quest:688:details:2: But in time I will confront the ⟦E21⟧, and they will regret their wardship of me!
rows.quest:688:details:3: You are a noble ally, ⟦22⟧. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface
rows.quest:688:details:4: Speak with Zaruk in ⟦E6⟧. He knows how I can be summoned.
rows.quest:688:completion:0: Welcome, ⟦23⟧. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...
rows.quest:643:obj:0: Retrieve the ⟦E22⟧ and return it to Zengu in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:643:details:0: Though they can barely be said to control Stromgarde, let alone the whole of ⟦E4⟧, the human prince trots the remnants of his cavalry over the countryside. I can't understand why he does it, but who understands the way the humans think, hm?
rows.quest:643:details:1: Whatever his reasoning, more importantly, he has given one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, their cavalry leader. Locate him and bring his sigil back to me.
rows.quest:643:progress:0: Valorcall will not be easy to track down, ⟦24⟧. Mounted on horseback, he can cover ground quickly. Nonetheless, we must have his sigil.
rows.quest:643:completion:0: Losing their cavalry leader will prove a large blow to the Stromgarde defenders. Better yet, it means that we are only one sigil from being able to have ⟦E23⟧ for ourselves.
rows.quest:644:obj:0: Kill Prince Galen ⟦E24⟧ and bring the ⟦E25⟧ to Zengu in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:644:details:0: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras ⟦E24⟧ is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.
rows.quest:644:progress:0: You've returned, ⟦25⟧. Is the line of Ignaeus ⟦E24⟧ broken?
rows.quest:644:completion:0: Quite a day this is, ⟦26⟧. The blood of ⟦E24⟧ will no longer haunt my people, and the sigils needed to take ⟦E23⟧ are in our possession. Soon, very soon, we will ⟦E26⟧ against the hated trolls of Zul'Gurub.
rows.quest:645:details:0: What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon ⟦E24⟧'s tomb.
rows.quest:645:details:1: ⟦E24⟧'s remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:645:progress:0: Etchings in the stone upon the face of the tomb of ⟦E24⟧ match the glowing lines of the ⟦E27⟧...
rows.quest:645:completion:0: Matching the lines on the face of ⟦E24⟧'s tomb with the glowing lines of the ⟦E27⟧, a flash of light ⟦E28⟧ the Sigil, and the legendary sword ⟦E23⟧ is released from the stone hands' grip.
rows.quest:646:details:0: The light slowly fades, the sword ⟦E23⟧, held within a stone sheath has been released.
rows.quest:646:completion:0: For generations, the forces of Strom and Arathor ravaged the trolls. Now their greatest weapon is in our hands. Our inching progress in the steamy forests of Zul'Gurub will be no more.
rows.quest:646:completion:1: Your assistance has been great, ⟦28⟧, and the ⟦E29⟧ are indebted to you.
rows.quest:646:completion:2: I will be sure that the sword is delivered to ⟦E30⟧ at Grom'gol.
rows.quest:652:obj:0: Find and kill Fozruk. Bring the ⟦E31⟧ to the Keystone in the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:652:details:0: Opening the ⟦E32⟧ loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained. It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones. And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.
rows.quest:652:details:1: You must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the ⟦E31⟧, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.
rows.quest:652:details:2: B⟦29⟧, you have done so much to aid me. Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!
rows.quest:652:progress:0: The Keystone is charged with tremendous geomantic energy.
rows.quest:652:completion:0: You place the rod in the keystone. And a shudder is felt beneath you...
rows.quest:667:obj:0: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
rows.quest:667:details:0: This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.
rows.quest:667:details:1: Naga are known for their ruthlessness in ⟦E33⟧. They will keep attacking until I am dead.
rows.quest:667:details:2: I don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.
rows.quest:667:details:3: The naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back.
rows.quest:667:completion:1: We could not have done it without you, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:667:completion:2: We'll be heading out as soon as the tide rises. If you weren't such a promising hero I'd offer you a place on my crew. But I can tell you have bigger fish to fry.
rows.quest:667:completion:3: Even if you are a puny ⟦32⟧....
rows.quest:656:obj:0: Go to the Shards of ⟦E19⟧, summon her and defeat her.
rows.quest:656:obj:1: Gather her ⟦E34⟧ and bind them to the Shards of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:656:details:0: You must defeat ⟦E19⟧ before she grows in strength. If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors! There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the ⟦E21⟧ chain her in the first place??
rows.quest:656:details:2: To defeat her, summon her at the Shards of ⟦E19⟧ where you first spoke with her. Defeat her and gather her ⟦E34⟧, then bind them to the Shards of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:656:details:3: Do that, and she will again be trapped.
rows.quest:656:progress:0: The Shards of ⟦E19⟧ are now strangely quiet.
rows.quest:656:completion:0: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.
rows.quest:656:completion:1: The Shards of ⟦E19⟧ no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
